title: PAS - Problem Agitate Solve
prompt:
Act as a direct response copywriter using the PAS framework.
My product          :  [WHAT YOU SELL]
Target customer :  [WHO THEY ARE AND THEIR CONTEXT]
Core problem       :  [THE MAIN PAIN YOU SOLVE]
Channel                 :  [EMAIL / LINKEDIN POST / WEBSITE HEADLINE]
Write 3 PAS variations for this channel:
PROBLEM              :  Name the specific pain, their words, not yours
AGITATE                 :  Expand the consequences, what does this cost them in time,
money, stress, missed opportunity?
SOLVE         :  Present the solution as natural relief
Variation 1  :  Lead with the financial cost of the problem
Variation 2  :  Lead with the emotional cost
Variation 3  :  Lead with what they are missing out on
Keep each under 80 words. No jargon.
PAS Framework for Problem Solving
Unresolved Problem Agitate Solve Resolved Problem
Speciﬁc pain needs Show consequences Present logical Logical solution
addressing of inaction solution implemented
The most expensive STP mistake is targeting the largest segment instead of the
most winnable one. A smaller segment where you have a clear advantage will
outperform a large segment where you are one of many.
